patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient was brought to the emergency department because of sudden, painless loss of vision in her right eye that occurred 30 minutes ago while watching TV. She has a history of coronary artery disease, hypertension, and type 2 diabetes mellitus but has had trouble adhering to her medication regimen.

Symptoms.Primary_Symptom: Sudden, painless loss of vision in the right eye

patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: Coronary artery disease, hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Has difficulty adhering to medication regimen

objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with sudden loss of vision in one eye.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Hello doctor—about 30 minutes ago while I was watching TV, I suddenly had painless loss of vision in my right eye. I’m a 60-year-old woman with coronary artery disease, hypertension, and type 2 diabetes, and I’ve had trouble sticking to my medications.”

turns.doctor_question: To help me get a better picture of your overall health, could you tell me if you currently smoke or have a history of smoking?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t currently smoke and I’ve never been a smoker.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of how you're feeling, have you been experiencing any nausea or feeling sick to your stomach lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had nausea or any stomach upset—just the sudden, painless vision loss in my right eye that started about 30 minutes ago.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your health, have you noticed any lumps or masses in your breast area that do not cause you any pain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lumps or masses in my breast area, and they wouldn’t be painful either—I just have the sudden, painless vision loss in my right eye that began about 30 minutes ago.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand that physical symptoms can sometimes be linked to how we are feeling emotionally. To help me get a clearer picture of your overall well-being, have you been experiencing a significant amount of psychological stress lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t been feeling significant psychological stress lately—my main issue is the sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye that started about 30 minutes ago.”

turns.doctor_question: To help me better understand your current symptoms, have you noticed any changes in the color of your urine, specifically if it has appeared darker than usual?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any changes in the color of my urine—it isn’t darker than usual. It’s only been the sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye that began about 30 minutes ago.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand that finding a change in your breast can be concerning. To help me better understand what you are experiencing, have you noticed if the mass has been growing or changing in size rapidly?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lumps or masses at all, so nothing has been growing or changing in size—my only problem is the sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye that started about 30 minutes ago.”

turns.doctor_question: I'm sorry to hear you're not feeling well. To help me better understand what you're experiencing, could you please tell me if you are currently having any pain in your wrist?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I’m not having any pain in my wrist. The only problem I have is the sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye that began about 30 minutes ago.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a clearer picture of what’s going on, could you please check your arms for me? Have you noticed any skin lesions, such as rashes, bumps, or marks, running along the path of your veins?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I don’t notice any rashes, bumps, or unusual marks along the veins in my arms—there’s just the sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye that started about 30 minutes ago.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your health, I’d like to ask about your breathing: Do you find that you experience shortness of breath or difficulty catching your breath when you are physically active, such as walking or climbing stairs?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any shortness of breath or trouble catching my breath when I’m active—I’m only dealing with the sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye that started about 30 minutes ago.”
